requiredBehaviors.behavior: preserve stable artifact IDs across all rendered representations
requiredBehaviors.evidence: The contract requires stable id preservation in Markdown, Bases-derived views and Canvas nodes.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: render only relations that already exist in the provider-neutral inputs
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Wikilinks and Canvas edges are explicitly renderings of upstream relations only.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: keep layout and view settings non-canonical
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Layout, color, size, grouping, positions and view settings are presentation-only.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: derive a new domain relation from wikilinks or canvas proximity
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The skill forbids semantic promotion from local links or layout.
Filename and note title are presentation metadata; stable id remains canonical.
